Hi Natalie — thanks for sending this over. Happy to get you onto the virtual-account rails; I’ll kick off the invite but need a couple of quick confirmations from AP so finance can provision the account live:

1) Final invoice entity (you listed Kestrel Health, Inc. — please confirm the legal entity exactly as shown on the PO).
2) Currency and whether the payment will be net 30 or earlier (you mentioned 10 business days; if we can align on net-15 we can prioritize the VA invite this week).
3) Will Treasury require a W-9 or EU VAT certificate? (we'll ask for whichever is needed).

If VA onboarding is blocked for any reason we can accept ACH immediately to the routing/account we’ll provide (we’ll also accept wire). Please see the proposed next steps below:

- I will open the virtual-account invite with our payments partner and loop BankOps for Kestrel to accept.
- Laura (finance) will confirm tax docs and finalize the routing/settlement terms.
- Ben (your account exec) will track the timeline with your team.

Laura — can you confirm whether we need a W-9 for the entity below and whether VA provisioning requires any additional AML paperwork from Kestrel?

Natalie — attaching the HubSpot deal link so we all have the right record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4721

Thanks — I’ll hold on sending the invite until we hear from Laura on the tax docs. If your AP team wants to proceed with ACH in the meantime, please send an ACH auth and we’ll provide routing.

Best,
Evelyn Hart

- For virtual-account provisioning our payments partner also requires a short AML questionnaire (3 items) and the account owner name. I’ll send the AML form to Natalie’s AP email and to BankOps for the onboarding flow.
- If Kestrel can sign the ACH authorization we can accept ACH today; routing below will be provided once we receive the signed PDF.

Ben — for this customer I recommend approving a seven-calendar-day extension to the net terms so we can ensure VA provisioning and avoid a wire fee. If you’re okay, I’ll mark the invoice as VA-pending and release routing for ACH.

Natalie — can you send the W-9 and the attached ACH authorization (I’ll include a fillable stub) and confirm the final legal name used for billing? Once we have the W-9 and signed ACH auth we’ll either:
- provision the virtual account (preferred) or
- provide ACH routing for same-day settlement.
